name: Armada Cannabis Co. | 50mg Live Rosin Cider | Triple Jam
description: A cannabis twist on the classic Michigan favorite from our friends at the farm. Triple Jam blends strawberry, blackberry, and raspberry for a sweet, jammy burst of flavor. Powered by 50mg of nano-emulsified THC for a smooth, reliable experience. Alcohol-free.
